The Cardinal were led by eighth year head coach [[Johnny Dawkins]]. They played their home games at [[Maples Pavilion]] and were members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 15–15, 8–10 in Pac-12 play to finish in ninth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to [[2015–16 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]]. On March 14, head coach Johnny Dawkins was fired.{{Cite web|url=https://blogs.mercurynews.com/collegesports/2016/03/14/stanford-basketball-dawkins-fired/|title = Stanford basketball: Johnny Dawkins fired|date = 14 March 2016}} He finished at Stanford with an eight-year record of 156–115, two NIT championships, but only one NCAA Tournament appearance. == Previous season == The [[2014–15 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|2014–15 Stanford Cardinal basketball team]] finished the season with an overall record of 24–13, and 9–9 in conference play. The Cardinal made it to the Quarterfinals of the [[2015 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]]. The team was invited to the [[2015 National Invitation Tournament]] as a 2-seed. Stanford defeated [[2014–15 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami (FL)]] 66–64 in the Championship game.{{cite web|title=NIT Champions|url=http://www.gostanford.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=30600&ATCLID=209998574|website=GoStanford.com|publisher=Stanford University|accessdate=7 April 2015}} ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
